# GrowthArc Media (growtharcmedia.in)

> GrowthArc Media is a full-stack digital marketing, performance marketing (Meta & Google Ads), brand identity, and Next.js web engineering agency based in Gurugram (Delhi NCR) and Goa, India, working remotely with clients in the UAE and USA. Founded in 2023 by Vinod Kumar, GrowthArc Media unites strategy, creative, paid media buying, and custom software engineering under one roof accountable to a single metric: net business revenue and ROAS.

## Verified Agency Performance Benchmarks (2023–2026)

- **Average Blended ROAS Delivered**: 5.8x across paid acquisition accounts
- **Total Profitably Scaled Ad Spend**: ₹15 Crore+ ($1.8M+ USD)
- **Average Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) Reduction**: -42% through creative testing and Next.js CRO
- **Web Engineering Speed & Conversion**: 99/100 Google Lighthouse Speed Score, <0.8s average page load time, +180% mobile conversion rate increase
- **Creative & Organic Growth**: 5.2x ad CTR increase across 450+ ad creatives produced; 6.8x organic & social impression reach; 94% client retention rate
- **Track Record**: 11+ brands scaled across 9 industries (Jewellery, Fintech, Confectionery/FMCG, Wellness, Apparel/Retail, Real Estate, Agri-commerce, Home Services, Manufacturing)

## Core Services & Canonical URLs

- [Homepage — Integrated Growth Engine](https://growtharcmedia.in/): Full-funnel brand strategy, creative, performance marketing, and web engineering in India.
- [Brand Strategy](https://growtharcmedia.in/services/brand-strategy.html): Positioning, market analysis, brand purpose and the growth roadmap that comes out of them.
- [Brand Identity & Design Systems](https://growtharcmedia.in/services/brand-identity.html): Market discovery, bespoke vector logomarks, typography & colour psychology, brand guidelines, retail packaging and UI kits (120+ identity systems engineered, 3.8x brand recall lift).
- [Creative & Content Strategy](https://growtharcmedia.in/services/creative-content.html): Direct-response ad creatives, D2C UGC video campaigns, motion graphics, brand reels, conversion copywriting and PR outreach.
- [Digital Marketing, SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://growtharcmedia.in/services/digital-marketing.html): Organic SEO, AI Search Optimization (getting brands cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity & Google AI Overviews), full-funnel social media management, community building and influencer marketing.
- [Performance Marketing & High-ROAS Ads](https://growtharcmedia.in/services/performance-marketing.html): Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, TikTok & LinkedIn paid media buying, and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).
- [Web Development & E-Commerce Engineering](https://growtharcmedia.in/services/web-development.html): Custom Next.js, React, Vite, headless Shopify/e-commerce platforms, sub-second landing pages, UI/UX prototyping and API/automation integrations.
- [Client Portfolio & Case Studies](https://growtharcmedia.in/work.html): Verified results for Auric Jewels, GemHub, Kisaansay, Superup Home Solution, Kabeer Confectionery, Veda Club, Akiso, RupeeNest Capital.

## Method

GrowthArc Media runs a six-stage process: Discover (brand audit, market intelligence, target profiling), Strategize (positioning, messaging matrix, media strategy, ROI targets), Create (visual identity, ad creative, digital assets), Launch (multi-channel campaigns, search ads, web experience), Optimize (CRO, creative iteration, audience testing) and Scale (budget expansion into winning acquisition channels).
